component: RC HTTP response and native streaming adapter
selection: RC inherits native response framing, MIME mappings and cookie formatting. Metadata/SAPI/HEAD/bodyless/conditional adapters and a facade-owned large-file completion wrapper remain in RC. Native protocol, response, TCP transport, Chunk and SSE files are unchanged.
reason: Avoid encoded-packet bodies, conflicting framing, dropped error headers and premature close/reentrant dispatch during native backpressured file streams. Normal strings retain their direct native transport path.
internal_dependency: Large-file receive-pause ownership reads native TcpConnection::isPaused via one cached ReflectionProperty. No protected transport fields are mutated. Public send/pauseRecv/resumeRecv/buffer-size/callback APIs and the native public context streamSending flag coordinate completion.
scope: Response checkpoint, not complete framework, proxy, logger-process, shutdown-quota, sustained-resource or Micro/encrypted binary acceptance.
